tvāṃ devi manasābhyarcya soḍaśai rūpa cārakaiḥ || 11 ||

navakhaṇḍā yathā bhūmirna ca khaṇḍātmakaṃ tathā || 34 ||

ma vāśineya ityāhu rāgneyaṃ pañca pañcakam || 39 ||

nama śivāya ityevaṃ praṇavāntāṃ punaḥ priye || 70 ||

nama śivāya ityevaṃ praṇavāntāṃ punaḥ priye || 70 ||
aṃguṣṭhe tu yakāraḥ syāt vākāraṃ tarjanī nyaset || 6 ||
kaniṣṭhe tu na rautaṃ syāt sṛṣṭimārgeṇa ceśvarī || 7 ||
gulphapāṇyośca jaṃghe ca jānvorū guhya deśake || 8 ||
kukṣau nābhau yathā yogaṃ samaṃ yaṃ praṇavaṃ priye ||
kaṇṭhe karṇāsthi gāsye tu nāsāgre ca yathā kramam || 4 ||
ādyaṃ śivaṃ bhruvormadhye madhye haṃsa sudīptakam || 5 ||
jāntaṃ nṛtyañca saṃyuktaṃ candrakhaṇḍaṃ ca dakṣiṇe || 7 ||
